dossier_meta.statement_text: $t(n)=n-2$ if and only if $n$ is prime.
dossier_meta.context_text: The function $t(n)$ denotes the diameter of the swap graph on cyclic permutations when all swaps (not necessarily adjacent) are allowed. Observation 3.1 and Proposition 3.2 together establish that the condition holds whenever $n=2$ or $n$ is an odd prime, providing one direction of the biconditional.
